title: Rees chart locality commutes with the actual fibre at one
statement: For a finite commutative coefficient ring A and a Noetherian smooth separated quasi-compact compactifiable g:V→S with closed section s and s g=1, assume the actual extended-Rees projection is compactifiable. For each centred chart c of [def-trf-section-centred-chart-data], let sourceMap and familyMap be the orientation-free maps to the standard zero-section invariants and standardFibreMap the actual standard one-fibre mate of [def-trf-section-coordinate-chart-maps]. Then i1*(familyMap) followed by standardFibreMap equals restrictedTheta of [def-trf-section-local-comparison-data] followed by sourceMap. No Tate orientation or normalized affine adjunction occurs in this assertion.

proof.text: Use base-change transitivity on c.reesBase and the one-fibre square. The Rees upper maps agree at one, and the section compositor identifies the outer map with restrictedTheta.

proof.text: Apply counit-normalized etale locality/fibre compatibility to c.reesOpen and c.reesCoordinates. At one their upper maps are c.j and c.e; the standard Rees coordinate map is identity there. The proved augmentation equations identify the centres with zero. Paste the open-locality square and the inverse coordinate-locality square with the base-change square, cancel inverse locality maps, and use inverse-image compositor coherence. The resulting equality is the stated orientation-free square.

theorem sectionCoordinateChart_restriction (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {V S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] (d : ℕ) (g : V ⟶ S)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g] [IsSeparated g] [QuasiCompact g]
    [HasCompactification g] (s : S ⟶ V) [IsClosedImmersion s]
    (hs : s ≫ g = 𝟙 S)
    [HasCompactification (Scheme.Hom.deformationSpaceProj g s)] (c : Chart d g s hs) :
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
      (AffineSpace.oneSection (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) c.T)).leftDerivedFunctor.map
        (SectionCoordinateChartMaps.familyMap A d g s hs c) ≫
      SectionCoordinateChartMaps.standardFibreMap A c.T d =
    restrictedTheta A g s hs c.b ≫ SectionCoordinateChartMaps.sourceMap A d g s hs c
